name: Collateral Cadet
cadence: When Katherine asks (the Box answers within 15 minutes)

sources.label: Katherine's Collateral Map (107 materials)
sources.why: read every 15 minutes on the Box; on 10.13.2026 none of the 107 titles carried a link, so each is looked up in Drive by its exact name

sources.label: Canva designs
sources.why: the Box has no Canva connection that can read a design's text; Canva materials show as Not checked

does: Answers "where does this appear?": Katherine types a phrase and he lists every material on the Collateral Map and every page of our 11 websites that has it, with the line quoted
Reads the Collateral Map every 15 minutes and lists the titles that have no link yet, so Katherine knows which ones he cannot open for certain
Fills in a Change Log entry on Dispatch with the places he found, for Katherine to check and post

traits.instead: Lists every place so a person can make the change; making the edits for Katherine's review is a later step that needs Mimi's go

traits.cant: Read a Canva design, a PDF or a file that is not shared with the Brain
traits.instead: Marks it Not checked with the reason, never as clean; a PDF Drive has indexed can still show as Found

traits.cant: Search website headers, footers and menus on the WordPress sites
traits.instead: Uses each site's own search for page and post text, and reads every page of the three Squarespace sites

needs: A link on each title of the Collateral Map to its file (Drive or Canva), so he opens the right one instead of guessing by name
